title: Effect of mycogenic silver nanoparticles as a biocide on Schistosoma mansoni cercariae and Aedes aegypti larvae and their impact on non-target microcrustaceans
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,2364-2372
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00867K, Paper
Luiz Gustavo Ribeiro, Lenita de Freitas Tallarico, Patrícia Aoki Miyasato, Lincoln Suesdek, Fernanda Almeida Lopes, Rafael Guglielmelli Sepulvene, Eliana Nakano, Edison Barbieri, Ana Olivia de Souza
Biogenic silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) obtained using extracellular biomolecules from the extremophilic fungus Aspergillus tubingensis (AgNP-AT) present a promising cercaricidal activity.
